documentation: Canonical artifact registry of the stack wheels this project installs (R01, 2026-10-07). Source of truth for repository, release tag, asset and sha256; `python tools/stack_wheels.py fetch` downloads them through the GitHub API into the flat index `.stack-wheels/` (gitignored) and `uv.lock` pins them there by name and version. Change a wheel here (new version = new entry) and run `uv lock`; `python tools/stack_wheels.py check` fails when registry, index, uv.lock and pyproject.toml disagree or when a release URL reappears in the lock.
